svg.title: Planit Stage 2 — planning domain (selected fields and methods)

g.text: Planit Stage 2 — planning domain (selected fields and methods)
+revise(userId: String, start: LocalDateTime, due: LocalDateTime): Task
Pending selection differs from execution approval.
Existing alternatives without approval block F03/F04 generation.
Approved tasks/schedule are retained on blueprint switch;
review flags do not automatically reconcile content.
Record compartments list selected components (accessors implicit).
Nullable references: 0..1; collections may be empty.
Immutable records can be shared by snapshots: no exclusive composition asserted.
ID dependencies are not direct Java object references.
Hollow diamond: shared aggregation; team membership may initially be empty.
